div.div:
Tenant Resolution + Cache Lookup:
1: TenantFilter extracts tenant from subdomain
2: Try tenant metadata cache:
- cache hit -> set TenantContext
- cache miss -> DB lookup -> populate cache -> set TenantContext

school email + password
User submits: admision@school.edu
Extract email domain
compare email domain to tenant's domain from cache
mach -> contine
mismatch-> reject (spoofing attempt)

With Caching in step 1:
We avoid repeated tenant config / database hits on every login
We will still validate user specific data securely on login
Subscription status and domain mappings are read from cache, then validated per request
